reasoning_traces.think:
The system design enforces a dual-tiered execution strategy: local lightweight processing and cloud-accelerated retrieval. The 4-Tier classifier partitions repositories by computational demand, ensuring that high-CPU or high-RAM tasks do not overload the i7-1255U. Pinecone hybrid search offloads retrieval to reduce local memory pressure below 25 MB. Bazel governs builds to avoid exceeding 75% of host resources. These primitives form a closed-loop system where hardware constraints dictate execution policy, and telemetry ensures compliance. Failure modes include OOM crashes from unclassified repos or cloud credential misconfigurations. The design reflects a robust, adaptive architecture that balances local autonomy with scalable infrastructure.
